content: Yaka paeluwana Yehoba i baek Yona elana i ba,
“Nu na Ninibe panuwa bwabwatana, ge wasa toto ya baunan elam nu wasaan elal.”
Inoke Yona Yehoba anana i hago ge i na Ninibe. He Ninibe panuwa bwabwatana hot, ebo gamwana ta nawaan nasi lan eton ta nawanawa-an.
Lan houwan elana, Yona i telipuna i nawanawa panuwa gamwanaa, inoke i papaatena i ba, “Lan poti ni mowasi abwe Yehoba Ninibe ni pasamwalekaleka.”

Ninibe gamagaliliyau Yabowaine wana baaba hi abulilek-an. Inoke i telipunaa bolo alaliya bwabwatal i na bolo alaliya kekeisi elal, hi ba ali galebu nihi palahikan ge kaliko toto bwasumu pupunona elana hi ginoliya nihi galoi.

Sauga Ninibe ana kin i hago Yona ga i ba ola, inoke i lutem wana abamisiyo wawasana elana ge wasawasa kalikona i palo yoho tuwanaa, yaka kaliko toto bwasumu pupunona elana hi ginoliya i galoi ge i misiyowa papakova gamwanaa.
Inoke baaba i patuna i na Ninibe ana tomina gegewel elal i ba:
Logugui hiwe i noem nau kin alowau ge o tolabe elama. Bahi gamagal o ebo bwasumu etega, ebo bulumwakau, sipi o goti, aanan ni aan ge wewel ni iim.

Gamagalau ge bwasumu tuwaliya nihi os kaliko toto bwasumu pupunona elana hi ginoliya, inoke nihi awanun gagasisi Yabowaine elana. Yaka wali pagan nanakil ali en nihi pek ge wali lohalohaveyan nihi paveyaho.
Ebo ta ginol ola, tab abwe Yabowaine ni atilomwan-agila ge wana nuwatu ni pil, yaka ana huga ni mowasi ge nige ta yayaomal?
Sauga Yabowaine gamagalau wali ginol i kite ge i kite wali pagan nanakil ali en iyaka hi pek, inoke i atilomwan-agil, nige i aapapanak-agil i oola valila wana baaba.

footnotes.text: Ginol labui ya nuwanak ginolina. Ninibe hi nuwanak wali gegi kaiweliya.
